title: 2-D CFAR Detector
text: Two-dimensional constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detector, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Size in cells of the guard region band} sets Widths of guard band; {CFAR algorithm} sets the noise power estimation, {Rank of order statistic}, {Size in cells of the training region band} sets the widths of training band, {Threshold factor method} sets the method to determine threshold factor, {Custom threshold factor}, {Probability of false alarm}, {OutputFormat} sets the format of detection results, {Output threshold detection} enables detection threshold output, {Output estimated noise power} enables detection threshold output, {Source of the number of detections} and {Maximum number of detections} sets the maximum number of detection indices. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input image real M -by- N matrix | real M -by- N -by- P array

ports.name: idx
ports.summary: Location of test cells 2 -by- L matrix of positive integers

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Detection results logical matrix (default) | real-valued matrix

params.name: CFAR algorithm
params.values: Noise power estimation algorithm CA (default) | GOCA | SOCA | OS

params.name: Rank of order statistic
params.values: Rank of order statistic 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Size in cells of the guard region band
params.values: Widths of guard band [1,1] (default) | nonnegative integer scalar | 2-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Size in cells of the training region band
params.values: Widths of training band [1,1] (default) | nonnegative integer scalar | 2-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Threshold factor method
params.values: Method to determine threshold factor Auto (default) | Input port | Custom

params.name: Probability of false alarm
params.values: Probability of false alarm 0.1 (default) | real scalar between 0 and 1

params.name: OutputFormat
params.values: Format of detection results CUT result (default) | Detection index

params.name: Output threshold detection
params.values: Enable detection threshold output off (default) | on

params.name: Output estimated noise power
params.values: Enable detection threshold output off (default) | on

params.name: Source of the number of detections
params.values: Source of the number of detections to report Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Maximum number of detections
params.values: Maximum number of detection indices to report 1 (default) | positive integer
